test_flush_after_compression_with_long_h: test that compressed messages are flushed to a new session's SQLite when conversation_history is longer than compressed messages
test_flush_with_stale_history_loses_mess: test that stale conversation_history causes message data loss when flushing to a new session
test_history_offset_zero_on_session_spli: test that history_offset is set to zero when the agent creates a new session during compression
test_history_offset_preserved_without_sp: test that history_offset is preserved as the original history length when no compression occurs
test_new_messages_extraction_after_split: test that all agent messages are extracted as new_messages when history_offset is zero after a session split
